label: Pro 3.0.0
title: A workbench for received invoices
lede: Pro 3.0.0 adds a browser workbench to the validation service: named users register received invoices, check and approve them with the four-eyes rule, and export them with an evidence bundle. The approval workflow is stable from this version. Nothing from 2.x was removed.

items.title: Register, check, approve, export
items.text: The workbench keeps documents and a hash-chained log in a data folder. Reviewers check, approvers approve, admins export, and the person behind each step comes from the sign-in, not from a typed name. Everyone gets only the buttons their role and the four-eyes rule allow.
items.codeTitle: Start it with a users file
items.code:
docker run -d -p 8080:8080 -v summand-data:/data \
  -v ./users.json:/etc/summand/users.json:ro \
  -e SUMMAND_WORKBENCH_DIR=/data \
  -e SUMMAND_USERS_FILE=/etc/summand/users.json \
  ghcr.io/weber-development/summand-server:3

# users.json
[
  { "name": "Anna",  "role": "reviewer", "tokenSha256": "<sha-256 of her token>" },
  { "name": "Bernd", "role": "approver", "tokenSha256": "<sha-256 of his token>" },
  { "name": "Chris", "role": "admin",    "tokenSha256": "<sha-256 of his token>" }
]

items.title: The whole path, recorded
items.text: Recorded from a real run of the server with the KoSIT sample invoice, three users and the HTTP API that the page uses. The reviewer cannot approve; the approver can only approve what somebody else checked.

items.title: Evidence bundle on export
items.text: Marking an invoice as exported archives the original with its validation result and the full event history. The ZIP can be checked by a third party with the included script, or with summand-inbox archive verify-bundle. It is unsigned.
items.codeTitle: Verify the log and a bundle
items.code:
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" localhost:8080/v1/workflow/verify | jq .events

unzip evidence-4711.zip -d evidence && node evidence/verify.mjs evidence

items.title: One page, two languages
items.text: The page at /app is plain HTML in German and English with a strict content security policy. We checked it with axe-core in headless Chromium (sign-in, list and detail view, no violations). We did not test with a screen reader.

note: The demo cannot show the page itself: it needs your own Docker host and users. Not verified: browsers other than Chromium, a screen reader, load, several server processes on one data folder. The text files inside the evidence bundle are in German. The archive and the evidence bundle are not reviewed by a tax advisor and not a certified GoBD system.
